property.name: Traits and Special Powers
property.value:
[Trait] SANDWORM SPECIAL RULES Sandworm Head, Sandworm Body, and Sandworm Tail are considered "Sandworm Parts". // During force construction, if you have added a Sandworm Part to your force, you must also add the other two Sandworm Parts to your force by paying their costs. Sandworm Parts can't be added to Sidelines. // Sandworm Parts can't be generated, replaced, or replace other characters. // When the Sandworm Head moves one or more squares, after resolutions place a friendly Sandworm Body in a square the Sandworm Head began its move in, then place a friendly Sandworm Tail in a square the Sandworm Body last occupied. // If the Sandworm Body is on your force, damage that would be taken by the Sandworm Head (after reducers) is taken by the Sandworm Body instead. If the Sandworm Tail is on your force, damage that would be taken by the Sandworm Body (after reducers) is taken by the Sandworm Tail instead. (If all Sandworm Parts are on the force, damage taken by the Head will click the Tail's dial.) Protected: Pulse Wave.
[Trait] HALF-BURIED Opposing characters 4 or more squares away can't target Sandworm Head.
[Attack] MULTIPLE JAWS Powers: Blades Claws Fangs Blades/Claws/Fangs. When Sandworm Head uses it, you may roll 2d6 and choose one to be the result.
[Damage] GHOST-EATER When Sandworm Head attacks, opposing characters can't use Shape Change or Super Senses. // If Sandworm Head is part of a Ghost Realm themed team, its attacks deal penetrating damage.

[Trait] THE GINGERBREAD GIANT When Colossal Gingerbread Man takes damage from an attack, after resolutions he may generate a Giant Crumb blocking terrain marker in a square within 3 squares, then knock back all characters adjacent to that marker. This game, that marker has "Adjacent characters can use Regeneration. When they do, remove this marker from the game."
[Attack] SUGARPLUM STOMP Powers: Quake Quake. When Colossal Gingerbread Man uses it, increase the damage dealt to characters in adjacent squares by +2.
